branches.compaction_suffix: need = (([obj+0xbd0] - [obj+0xbc8]) >> 4, arithmetic on the wrapped 64-bit difference) + [obj+0xb38], wrapping at 64 bits; when need != 0, append ' (%zu files need compaction)' with need at offset ebp + len('] max score ...' text), remaining 1000 - that offset; when need == 0, stop
branches.group_loop: for i in 0..count-1 (count signed 32-bit at obj+0x10, loop entered only when count > 0): append '%d ' with the element count (entry.end - entry.begin) >> 3, arithmetic shift on the wrapped 64-bit difference, printed as C %d (low 32 bits, signed); a group-line snprintf whose return is negative or reaches the remaining space breaks the loop with ebp unchanged for that line
branches.max_score_line: append '] max score %.2f' with the double at [obj+0xf38], into the remaining 1000 - ebp bytes; its return value is the length used for the compaction-suffix offset
branches.normal_path: when the special gate is false, start with an empty buffer and append 'files[' (6 chars, plain snprintf, ebp advances by 6 unconditionally)
branches.special_gate: special branch taken exactly when obj+0xa90 == 0 AND signed32(obj+0x10) > 1 AND obj+0xaf8 != 0.0 under ucomisd (NaN takes the branch via jp; -0.0 compares equal and does not)
branches.special_prefix: write 'base level %d level multiplier %.2f max bytes base %lu ' with (signed32(obj+0xaf0), obj+0xaf8 as double, [[obj+0x18] + signed32(obj+0xaf0) * 8] as qword), then continue at the 'files[' append with ebp = that line's length + 6
branches.strip_rule: after the group loop (or immediately when count <= 0): if ebp > 0, ebp -= 1, dropping the last character built so far (the trailing space of the last '%d ' line, or the '[' of 'files[' when no group line ran)

callees.snprintf: PLT 0x63f1210, used for the 'files[' append only; standard C semantics, not otherwise modelled
callees.snprintf_chk: PLT 0x63f0f30, used for every other append with flag 2 and unknown object size (-1); standard C semantics, not otherwise modelled

layout.obj_0x18: pointer to a qword array indexed by the signed base level
layout.obj_0xa90: flag byte selecting the special branch (zero selects it, with the other gate conditions)
layout.obj_0xa98: 24-byte group entries: begin qword, end qword, third qword never read
layout.obj_0xaf0: signed 32-bit base level for the special prefix
layout.obj_0xaf8: double level multiplier for the special prefix and gate
layout.obj_0xb38: qword added to the compaction count
layout.obj_0xbc8: qword subtracted from obj+0xbd0 for the compaction count
layout.obj_0xf38: pointer to the double printed as the max score

literals.0x96c108: base level %d level multiplier %.2f max bytes base %lu

return: the caller buffer pointer (r12, the out argument); the buffer is 1000 bytes
unknowns: The snprintf truncation arms are not pinned: tests keep total output well under 1000 bytes, so a group line whose return is negative or reaches the remaining space, and any truncation of the 'files[' or suffix appends, are outside the model.
The domain meaning of the groups, the max score, and the compaction count beyond the format strings is not claimed.
The six direct-call sites are sites only, not modelled; the callers' buffer setup is not claimed.
A negative base-level index into the obj+0x18 array is not exercised: the native code has no bounds check, and the model indexes a sequence by the signed value; tests use non-negative indices.
%.2f rounding: Python formatting and glibc printf agree on the tested values; general equivalence is not proven.

formatter.claim: whole-function group-report formatter: optional base-level prefix line, 'files[' plus one '%d ' element-count line per group, strip of the trailing separator, '] max score %.2f', and an optional ' (%zu files need compaction)' suffix; returns the caller buffer
